reuse.why: All providers share the new link guard and reuse bank lookup and sync processing, but Fintegra copies existing linking and downloading workflows and takeover repeats unlink state clearing.

duplication.why: The diff adds three substantial duplicate blocks: the provider linking workflow, transaction downloader, and local unlink field reset.

placement.why: Provider handlers, transport, configuration, and types follow existing layers, although an assertion-named helper now also performs account mutations.

scope.why: The changes stay focused on the four requested linking and provider capabilities, including minimal client updates for the expanded provider type.

maintainability.why: Centralized link checks simplify future rule changes, but copied provider workflows and mutation hidden inside an assertion increase maintenance costs.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked repeats unlinkAccount's local field reset; extracting that reset would allow takeover and ordinary unlinking to share it while retaining separate provider cleanup.

disguised_duplication.where: The Fintegra workflows and unlink reset are direct copies with provider substitutions rather than duplication concealed through restructuring.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink, closed-target rejection, replacement dispatch, and replacement-specific target validation, expanding from an assertion into a mutating takeover operation; all six linking handlers still call it.
